title: Protein Overnight Oats
description: A five-minute make-ahead breakfast with oats, skyr, whey, berries and seeds.
notes: Source: Original LettuceCook meal-plan recipe created for this app; it is not copied from a single online recipe. Nutrition is an approximate planning estimate and varies by brand. Substitutions: Replace skyr with lactose-free rahka/quark; use fortified soy yogurt plus a little extra whey for a dairy-free option; swap berries for chopped apple or pear.

steps.title: Combine the dry ingredients
steps.text: Add the oats, whey protein and chia seeds to a jar or lidded bowl.

steps.title: Add the chilled ingredients
steps.text: Add skyr, milk or fortified soy drink, and the frozen berries. Stir until no dry whey pockets remain.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, preferably overnight.

steps.title: Finish and eat
steps.text: Stir well. Add a splash of milk if it is too thick. Eat cold or microwave briefly in a microwave-safe bowl.

title: Savory Egg Rye Plate
description: Eggs, rye bread, cottage cheese and raw vegetables for a fast protein-rich breakfast.
notes: Source: Original LettuceCook meal-plan recipe created for this app; it is not copied from a single online recipe. Nutrition is an approximate planning estimate and varies by brand. Substitutions: Use 250 g egg whites plus one whole egg for less fat; replace cottage cheese with skyr or rahka; replace rye bread with another whole-grain bread.

steps.title: Cook the eggs
steps.text: Boil the eggs for 7–8 minutes, or fry them in a non-stick pan until the whites are set.

steps.title: Prepare the plate
steps.text: Toast the rye bread if preferred. Slice the tomato, cucumber and apple.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.text: Serve the eggs with rye bread, cottage cheese, vegetables and apple. Season with pepper and only a small amount of iodised salt if needed.

title: Quark Oat Pancakes
description: Simple blender pancakes using rahka, oats, eggs and banana, served with berries.
notes: Source: Original LettuceCook meal-plan recipe created for this app; it is not copied from a single online recipe. Nutrition is an approximate planning estimate and varies by brand. Substitutions: Replace rahka with skyr or blended cottage cheese; replace banana with 100 g apple purée; use gluten-free oats when required.

steps.title: Make the batter
steps.text: Blend or mash the quark, oats, eggs and banana until mostly smooth. Let the mixture stand for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Heat the pan
steps.text: Warm a non-stick pan over medium heat. Add a very light coating of rapeseed oil only if needed.

steps.title: Cook the first side
steps.text: Spoon the batter into 3–4 small pancakes. Cook until the edges look set and bubbles appear, about 3–4 minutes.

steps.title: Flip and finish
steps.text: Turn carefully and cook the second side for 2–3 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Microwave or thaw the berries and spoon them over the pancakes.

title: Skyr Muesli Fruit Bowl
description: A no-cook breakfast bowl with skyr, oats or unsweetened muesli, fruit, berries and seeds.
notes: Source: Original LettuceCook meal-plan recipe created for this app; it is not copied from a single online recipe. Nutrition is an approximate planning estimate and varies by brand. Substitutions: Use rahka or cottage cheese instead of skyr; use an apple or pear instead of banana; replace pumpkin seeds with 15–20 g walnuts or almonds.

steps.title: Prepare the fruit
steps.text: Slice the banana. Thaw the berries briefly in the microwave if you do not want them frozen.

steps.title: Build the bowl
steps.text: Add skyr to a bowl and top with muesli or oats, banana, berries and pumpkin seeds.

steps.title: Adjust the texture
steps.text: Add a small splash of milk or fortified soy drink if you prefer a looser consistency.

title: Chicken Rice Broccoli Box
description: The basic meal-prep box: lean chicken, rice, broccoli, carrot and rapeseed oil.
notes: Source: Original LettuceCook meal-plan recipe created for this app; it is not copied from a single online recipe. Nutrition is an approximate planning estimate and varies by brand. Substitutions: Replace chicken with turkey, lean pork tenderloin or 200–250 g firm tofu; replace rice with 90 g dry whole-wheat pasta or about 350–400 g potatoes; use any frozen vegetable mix.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.text: Rinse the rice. Cook it according to the package instructions, usually 12–15 minutes.

steps.title: Season the chicken
steps.text: Mix the chicken with pepper, garlic powder and half of the soy sauce.

steps.title: Cook the chicken
steps.text: Heat half the rapeseed oil in a pan. Cook the chicken, stirring, until browned and fully cooked through, about 8–10 minutes.

steps.title: Cook the vegetables
steps.text: Steam or microwave the broccoli and carrot until tender but not mushy, about 5–7 minutes.

steps.title: Pack the box
steps.text: Combine rice, chicken and vegetables. Add the remaining oil and soy sauce. Cool before covering if preparing ahead.

title: Oven Salmon Potatoes Peas Tray
description: A straightforward salmon tray with potatoes, peas and a dill-yogurt sauce.
notes: Source: Original LettuceCook meal-plan recipe created for this app; it is not copied from a single online recipe. Nutrition is an approximate planning estimate and varies by brand. Substitutions: Replace salmon with rainbow trout, Arctic char or another oily fish; use 150–180 g white fish plus 10 g extra rapeseed oil; replace potatoes with 80–90 g dry barley or rice.

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.text: Heat the oven to 220 °C conventional or 200 °C fan.

steps.title: Start the potatoes
steps.text: Toss the potato pieces with rapeseed oil, pepper and a small pinch of iodised salt. Roast for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Add the salmon
steps.text: Move the potatoes aside. Add the salmon, season with pepper, half the dill and half the lemon juice, and bake for another 10–12 minutes until it flakes easily.

steps.title: Heat the peas
steps.text: Microwave or simmer the peas for 3–4 minutes, then drain.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.text: Mix Greek yogurt with the remaining dill and lemon juice. Serve with the salmon, potatoes and peas.

title: Turkey Mince Tomato Pasta
description: Lean turkey mince, whole-wheat pasta, tomato and spinach in one fast pan sauce.
notes: Source: Original LettuceCook meal-plan recipe created for this app; it is not copied from a single online recipe. Nutrition is an approximate planning estimate and varies by brand. Substitutions: Replace turkey mince with chicken mince, lean beef mince or crumbled tofu; use lentil/chickpea pasta for more fibre and protein; use frozen spinach instead of fresh.

steps.title: Cook the pasta
steps.text: Boil the whole-wheat pasta until just tender. Reserve a small cup of pasta water, then drain.

steps.title: Soften the onion
steps.text: Heat rapeseed oil in a large pan and cook the onion for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Brown the turkey
steps.text: Add turkey mince. Break it apart and cook until no pink remains, about 6–8 minutes.

steps.title: Build the sauce
steps.text: Add passata, spinach, pepper, garlic powder and dried herbs. Simmer for 3–5 minutes.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Fold in the pasta. Add a splash of reserved pasta water if the sauce is too thick.

title: Red Lentil Chicken Soup
description: A filling one-pot soup with chicken, red lentils, tomato, carrot and spinach.
notes: Source: Original LettuceCook meal-plan recipe created for this app; it is not copied from a single online recipe. Nutrition is an approximate planning estimate and varies by brand. Substitutions: For a vegetarian version, omit chicken and add 150 g drained beans or 200 g tofu; replace red lentils with split peas but allow a longer cooking time; use frozen soup vegetables.

steps.title: Prepare the base
steps.text: Heat rapeseed oil in a pot. Cook onion and carrot for 4–5 minutes.

steps.title: Add chicken
steps.text: Add the chicken pieces and stir for 3–4 minutes so the outside turns opaque.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Add lentils, crushed tomatoes, water or broth, pepper, paprika and garlic powder. Bring to a boil, then simmer gently for 15–18 minutes until the lentils and chicken are cooked.

steps.title: Add spinach
steps.text: Stir in the spinach and cook for 2 minutes. Add more water if you prefer a thinner soup.

steps.title: Check seasoning
steps.text: Taste before adding salt because broth can already contain a lot. Use iodised salt sparingly if needed.

title: Tofu Quinoa Vegetable Wok
description: A plant-forward meal with tofu, quinoa, peas and a large portion of frozen vegetables.
notes: Source: Original LettuceCook meal-plan recipe created for this app; it is not copied from a single online recipe. Nutrition is an approximate planning estimate and varies by brand. Substitutions: Replace tofu with tempeh, soy strips or chicken; replace quinoa with brown rice, barley or whole-wheat noodles; use any 400 g mixture of frozen vegetables and peas.

steps.title: Cook the quinoa
steps.text: Rinse quinoa thoroughly, then simmer according to the package instructions, usually 12–15 minutes. Drain if necessary.

steps.title: Brown the tofu
steps.text: Heat half the rapeseed oil in a large pan. Cook tofu cubes on several sides for 6–8 minutes.

steps.title: Cook the vegetables
steps.text: Add the remaining oil, frozen mixed vegetables and peas. Stir-fry until hot and tender, about 6–8 minutes.

steps.title: Season and combine
steps.text: Add soy sauce, garlic, ginger or chilli if desired. Fold in quinoa and heat through.

title: Tuna Potato Cottage Cheese Bake
description: A compact high-protein bake using tuna, potatoes, cottage cheese, peas and egg.
notes: Source: Original LettuceCook meal-plan recipe created for this app; it is not copied from a single online recipe. Nutrition is an approximate planning estimate and varies by brand. Substitutions: Replace tuna with cooked chicken, salmon leftovers or white beans; replace cottage cheese with lactose-free cottage cheese or thick soy-based cooking product plus extra tofu; use frozen diced potatoes to save time.

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.text: Heat the oven to 210 °C conventional or 190 °C fan.

steps.title: Pre-cook the potatoes
steps.text: Microwave the potato cubes with a splash of water for 7–9 minutes, or boil until almost tender. Drain well.

steps.title: Mix the filling
steps.text: In a baking dish, mix tuna, cottage cheese, peas, egg, onion, pepper and dried herbs. Fold in the potatoes.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake until piping hot and set in the centre, about 18–22 minutes.

steps.title: Rest
steps.text: Let the bake stand for 3–5 minutes before eating.

title: Sheet-Pan Chicken Root Vegetables
description: Chicken and frozen or fresh root vegetables roasted together, served with yogurt and salad.
notes: Source: Original LettuceCook meal-plan recipe created for this app; it is not copied from a single online recipe. Nutrition is an approximate planning estimate and varies by brand. Substitutions: Replace chicken with turkey fillet, lean pork tenderloin or firm tofu; replace root vegetables with potatoes plus carrots; replace Greek yogurt with skyr or a fortified unsweetened soy alternative.

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.text: Heat the oven to 220 °C conventional or 200 °C fan.

steps.title: Season the tray
steps.text: Spread the root vegetables on a lined tray. Toss with rapeseed oil, pepper, paprika and garlic powder. Add the chicken and season it.

steps.title: Roast
steps.text: Roast for 20–25 minutes, turning the vegetables once, until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are browned.

steps.title: Prepare the sides
steps.text: While the tray cooks, wash and chop the salad vegetables. Stir pepper, herbs or lemon into the yogurt.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Slice the chicken and serve it with the roasted vegetables, salad and yogurt sauce.

title: Beef Bean Chili with Rice
description: One modest red-meat meal balanced with beans, vegetables and rice.
notes: Source: Original LettuceCook meal-plan recipe created for this app; it is not copied from a single online recipe. Nutrition is an approximate planning estimate and varies by brand. Substitutions: Replace half or all of the beef with extra beans, soy mince or lentils; replace rice with barley, quinoa or potatoes; use a frozen onion-pepper mix to reduce chopping.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.text: Cook rice according to the package instructions.

steps.title: Brown the beef
steps.text: Heat rapeseed oil in a saucepan. Add onion and beef, break up the mince and cook until browned, about 7–8 minutes.

steps.title: Add the vegetables
steps.text: Stir in kidney beans, crushed tomatoes, sweetcorn, paprika, cumin and chilli to taste.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Simmer uncovered for 10–12 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add water if it becomes too thick.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Taste before adding salt. Serve the chili with rice.

title: Turkey Tortilla Wraps
description: Quick whole-wheat wraps with turkey mince, yogurt and plenty of crunchy vegetables.
notes: Source: Original LettuceCook meal-plan recipe created for this app; it is not copied from a single online recipe. Nutrition is an approximate planning estimate and varies by brand. Substitutions: Replace turkey with chicken mince, lean beef, tofu crumble or beans; replace tortillas with rye bread or a rice bowl; use bagged salad and pre-cut vegetables for speed.

steps.title: Cook the turkey
steps.text: Cook turkey mince in a non-stick pan with paprika, cumin, garlic powder and pepper until browned and fully cooked, about 7–9 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare the vegetables
steps.text: Shred lettuce and dice tomato and cucumber while the turkey cooks.

steps.title: Warm the tortillas
steps.text: Warm tortillas in a dry pan or microwave for 20–30 seconds so they fold without tearing.

steps.title: Fill and roll
steps.text: Spread yogurt over each tortilla. Add turkey and vegetables, fold in the sides, then roll tightly.

title: Salmon Spinach Pasta Skillet
description: Salmon, whole-wheat pasta, peas, spinach and cottage cheese in a simple creamy skillet.
notes: Source: Original LettuceCook meal-plan recipe created for this app; it is not copied from a single online recipe. Nutrition is an approximate planning estimate and varies by brand. Substitutions: Replace salmon with rainbow trout, canned salmon or tuna; replace cottage cheese with skyr stirred in off heat; replace pasta with potatoes, barley or a pulse-based pasta.

steps.title: Cook the pasta
steps.text: Cook the pasta until just tender. Reserve about 100 ml pasta water, then drain.

steps.title: Cook the salmon
steps.text: Place salmon in a non-stick skillet over medium heat. Cook gently for 5–7 minutes, turning once, until nearly cooked.

steps.title: Add vegetables
steps.text: Add peas and spinach. Cook until the peas are hot and the spinach has wilted, about 3–4 minutes.

steps.title: Make it creamy
steps.text: Lower the heat. Fold in cottage cheese and a little pasta water; do not boil aggressively.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Add pasta, pepper, dill and lemon if available. Fold together and heat for 1–2 minutes.
